```{r load data, echo=FALSE}
#------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load vegetation data + taxon lifeform classifications
#------------------------------------------------------------
taxon.all <- read_sppmaster()
taxon.lifeform <- taxon.all %>%
  filter(Codetype %in% c("U", "X", "D")) %>%
  select(Code, ScientificName, EnglishName, Lifeform) %>%
  distinct()

trees <- taxon.lifeform %>% 
  filter(Lifeform %in% c("1", "2")) %>% 
  pull(Code)

tree_seedlings <- taxon.lifeform %>% 
  filter(Lifeform %in% c("1", "2")) %>% 
  mutate(Code = paste0(Code, "D")) %>% 
  pull(Code)

#------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Read lump table and apply combine_taxa()
#------------------------------------------------------------

veglump <- dbConnect(
  odbc::odbc(),
  .connection_string = "Driver={Microsoft Access Driver (*.mdb, *.accdb)}; DBQ=D:/BC_Correlation2_Vpro_2023/Correlation2_Spp_lump.accdb;"
)

lump <- dbReadTable(veglump, "CorrelationII_Lump")
dbDisconnect(veglump)

#veg.dat2 <- combine_taxa(vegdata = veg.dat, lump, use.subtaxa = FALSE)

#------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Load association summary data from two LMH databases
#------------------------------------------------------------
usa_assocs <- dbConnect(
  odbc::odbc(),
  .connection_string = "Driver={Microsoft Access Driver (*.mdb, *.accdb)}; DBQ=D:/BC_Correlation2_Vpro_2023/USA_Assocs/Coastal15Jan2004Constancy.accdb;"
)
ak <- dbReadTable(usa_assocs, "AK_Constancy") %>%   
  mutate(SiteUnit = str_replace_all(Unit, "/", "-"), Constancy = Constancy *100)
pnw <- dbReadTable(usa_assocs, "All15Jan2004Lumped_Constancy") %>%
  filter(!Version == "BEC") %>%
  mutate(SiteUnit = str_replace_all(paste0(Unit, "-", Version), "/", "-"), Constancy = Constancy *100)
usys <- dbReadTable(usa_assocs, "USysAllSpecs") 
dbDisconnect(usa_assocs)

usa_assocs <- bind_rows(ak, pnw) %>%
  select(SiteUnit, Species, MeanCov=Cover, Constancy, nplots = nPlots)
#------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Update veg codes
#------------------------------------------------------------
usa_assocs <- usa_assocs %>%
  left_join(taxon.all, by = c("Species" = "OldCode")) %>%
  mutate(Species.new = Code) 

missing <- usa_assocs %>% filter(is.na(Species.new)) %>% pull(Species) %>% unique
update <- usys %>%
  filter(
    Code %in% missing,
    str_detect(ScientificName, "\\ sp.")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Species.new = toupper(str_sub(ScientificName, 1, 8))
  ) %>% select(Code, Species.new)

usa_assocs <- usa_assocs %>%
  left_join(update, by = c("Species" = "Code"), suffix = c("", ".upd")) %>%
  mutate(
    Species.new = coalesce(Species.new, Species.new.upd)
  ) %>%
  select(-Species.new.upd)%>%
  mutate(
    Species.new = coalesce(Species.new, Species)
  )
usa_assocs <- usa_assocs %>%
  select(SiteUnit, Species, MeanCov, Constancy, nplots) %>%
  mutate(
    Species = recode(
      Species,
      "ABIECG" = "ABIEGRA",
      "VACCINIU" = "VACCOVL"
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct()



#------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save for use in associations script
#------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(usa_assocs, "./usa.summary.units/usa_assocs_vegdat.rds")
```
